name: Console commands
author: Brett
description: Tell Amber (any Claude session) to load a screen and your open console goes there: open any screen, dialog or settings tab (sub-tabs too) by id, title or a few words, run any registered action, go back or home, and list what the console has. The control@1 console domain over REST (/api/console), MCP tools console_open, console_dialog, console_settings, console_action, console_back, console_where, console_list and console_clients on the console's /mcp (and through axHub), and the CLI `axf console …`. Opening and moving only navigate; an action that changes data keeps its own permission, and one that deletes or resets needs a confirm token. Commands go to the console you used last (or all of them, or one). open_url on the console (s8): POST open-url {url, browser?, to?} with the phone's URL rule, GET open-url (history), POST open-url/{id}/cancel, the phone's pick-up and answer, settings browser / openUrlViaHub / openUrlNotifyWhenBlocked.
